verdict.rationale: Hightouch runs on top of the customer's own data warehouse without copying data into a separate system, and Events data is stored in the customer's warehouse. A community report adds that, out of the box, no data is stored in Hightouch itself. So residency is indirectly controlled by where the user hosts their warehouse or S3 bucket, not by a Hightouch region setting. Missing for 10: an explicit Hightouch workspace region/data-residency selection (e.g., US/EU hosting), documentation of where Hightouch's own processing and metadata reside, and first-party residency/compliance docs.
